data.long_meaning: Man of God. The name Manel carries the meaning “Little One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Manel usually hope their child will grow to embody little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manel total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
